kitDescription: A2 is a charge-shot rocket launcher whose burst, Mode B, is a pure self-buff state with no burst damage of its own: while it lasts she gains ATK and Charge Speed, but it drains 3.99% of her current HP every second and switches itself off once she falls below 40% HP, giving the buffs a bounded uptime each 40-second burst cycle. Casting her burst also briefly boosts her Charge Damage and Explosion Radius for 15 seconds. Every full-charge shot — which for her is every shot — splashes an extra 30.1% of her final ATK onto the target and gives her a short 3-second Damage-to-Parts buff. In game terms she is a self-sufficient charge-RL carry: her burst makes her charge faster and hit harder for a window, then goes quiet until her next cast.

verdictRationale: No real gotchas: every kit line is either faithfully encoded or a documented, formula-sanctioned gap, and the blind re-derivations converged with the driver on every stat, trigger, target, and the unmodeled set. The single RED blind assertion (teammate byte-inertness of the 30.1% rider) is a RECON_ERROR, not a driver defect — the SSOT (§6, MEASURED maiden precedent) requires skill hits to generate burst gauge, so removing the rider legitimately perturbs cast-frame alignment team-wide while Full Burst count (11) and a2 cast count (6) are provably unchanged; the S5 inertness template should be tightened for gauge-generating procs. The sole material S5/S6 divergence, Mode B durationSec 22.5 (driver) vs 15 (blind), is measurement-gated magnitude, out of gotcha scope: both authors independently derived the same 22.5s ceiling from the kit's own drain constant, the driver enacted it with an honest ⚑ naming the 15.04s max-HP alternative and a footage-pin recipe, and both values pass the blind test's finite band while the permanent-encoding nearest-wrong is behaviourally excluded. Discrimination holds on all four load-bearing lines (additive-vs-multiplicative charge stat numerically separated, burstCast-vs-fullBurstEnter behaviourally separated by the helm co-B3 fixture, lastBullet counterfactual under-fires, permanent Mode B over-credits). Same-model residuals the owner should spot-check: (1) the 22.5s Mode B derivation rests on the shared 'current-HP compound' reading of 'Current HP ▼3.99%' — a banner-to-drop footage pin would settle it against the 15.04s linear reading; (2) shotFired-as-full-charge-proxy assumes every RL pull is a full charge under auto — true per §2a but worth one cadence sanity check against real footage if this unit is ever board-graded.
